title: A root file named __all__ cannot be selected alone in a multi-file turn review
classification: formal static source finding; no dynamic UI validation
ordinaryTrigger: A normal multi-file historical turn snapshot includes root-relative file __all__ and at least one other file. The existing review card sends its actual snapshot; parsed paths are reused directly as Select values. No malformed DTO, permissions or unusual OS behavior is required.
contract: The turn file dropdown is a single-file filter, and the AI draft request is intended to review exactly the selected historical file. Its root-relative file-name domain does not reserve __all__.
cause: ReviewPanel uses __all__ as the All-files sentinel and also emits every actual parsed path verbatim as an option value. Both choices therefore have the same string state. activeTurnFileSel===ALL_FILES converts that actual path to null before both viewer.onlyPath and selectReviewSnapshot.

staticValueFlow.meaning: Actual review click sends files.map(path) and sessionDiffText.
Normal a/__all__/b/__all__ and ---/+++ paths survive as root-relative __all__; no sentinel reservation.
Sentinel and actual file use identical option/state value.
Nonempty __all__ remains the same value through onChange; no filename encoding or separate option identity.
That state becomes null onlyPath and null snapshot filter, so both paths choose the entire snapshot.
null intentionally means whole snapshot; helper itself behaves as specified.

expectedStaticScope: Only the __all__ file chunk when choosing that real file.
actualStaticScope: The state has no representation distinct from All files; viewer receives null onlyPath and AI snapshot preparation receives the full turnDiff/undefined file label.
impact: The exact root filename cannot be narrowed in a multi-file turn review; both displayed review scope and prepared draft scope remain All. This is one cause, not separate viewer/AI findings.
counterevidence: Requires at least2 parsed files because the file dropdown is hidden for a single file. A lone __all__ file has no extra-file scope impact.
Normal distinct paths including nested dir/__all__ do not equal the sentinel. All-files selection itself is intended.
selectReviewSnapshot(diff,null) returning the entire diff is correct; no defect is assigned to the helper null branch.

Source is sufficient to show identical state values. No actual existing user repository containing this name, UI click, Radix exception, prompt delivery, model behavior or browser result was observed.
No cross-permission/security/custody/identity implication; no sensitive-data or auto-send claim.
validation: Static only:0product/import/test/fixture/React/browser/native/network attempts. Existing tests are read, not passed evidence.
